pack.topic: Roof Sheet Cross-Break Stiffening for Wind Resistance
pack.source_script_insight: Cross-break creasing (X-shaped diagonal stiffening lines) formed manually across thin-gauge sheet metal panels prevents oil-canning (flexing/drumming) and provides structural rigidity without adding weight.
pack.coimbatore_angle: Coimbatore experiences high wind velocities (especially during Aadi wind season), causing flat metal sheet roofing and utility cladding on residential terraces to rattle, flex, and drum loudly if un-stiffened.
pack.core_takeaway: Cross-break diagonal creasing on flat metal sheets stops wind vibration and drumming noise on Coimbatore residential roofs.

pack.gemini_video_prompt:
OliveTree Builders video concept. Target Location: COIMBATORE ONLY. Total Duration: EXACTLY 10 SECONDS. Exactly 7 Scenes. PHOTOREALISTIC LIVE-ACTION-STYLE REAL FOOTAGE. Format: Vertical 9:16 portrait native layout. Must look 90%+ like real smartphone/gimbal video shot on an actual Coimbatore construction site with natural daylight, authentic dust, red brick context, real workers, and galvanised sheet metal materials.

SCENE BREAKDOWN (10 SECONDS TOTAL):
- SCENE 1 (0.0 - 1.4s): Close-up of a flat galvanised iron sheet on an outdoor residential terrace structure in Coimbatore flexing violently in high wind. Visual text overlay: 'Roof Sheet Noise?'. Voiceover: 'கோவை காற்றில் roof sheet சத்தம் போடுதா?'
- SCENE 2 (1.4 - 2.8s): 45-degree close-up shot of a worker pushing down on the center of an un-stiffened sheet metal panel, causing oil-canning drumming and popping wobble. Visual text overlay: 'Flat Sheet Flexes'. Voiceover: 'பிளாட் ஷீட் காற்றில் வளையும்!'
- SCENE 3 (2.8 - 4.2s): Medium shot on site showing a craftsman tracing neat diagonal 'X' cross lines across a flat galvanized sheet metal panel. Visual text overlay: 'X-Cross Breaking'. Voiceover: ''X' வடிவில் cross-break மடிப்பு தேவை!'
- SCENE 4 (4.2 - 5.6s): Extreme close-up of a worker using a hand creasing dolly tool to press a sharp diagonal structural rib fold into the metal sheet. Metallic reflection in bright daylight. Visual text overlay: 'Stiffening Crease'. Voiceover: 'டூல் மூலம் X-மடிப்பு செய்கிறோம்.'
- SCENE 5 (5.6 - 7.0s): Close-up of hand pressing heavily on the center of the X-creased panel—it stays rock solid without flexing or drumming sound. Visual text overlay: 'High Rigidity'. Voiceover: 'இதனால் structural strength அதிகரிக்கும்!'
- SCENE 6 (7.0 - 8.5s): Low-angle tracking shot of cross-creased sheet metal panels installed cleanly as cladding on a terrace shade structure of a Coimbatore home, remaining totally rigid in strong wind. Visual text overlay: 'No Wind Vibration'. Voiceover: 'ஷீட் flex ஆகாது, சத்தமும் வராது!'
- SCENE 7 (8.5 - 10.0s): High-quality real-world shot of a finished modern residential terrace in Coimbatore built by OliveTree Builders, with clean subtle text overlay: 'OliveTree Builders'. Voiceover: 'தரமான roofing-க்கு OliveTree Builders!'

CONTINUITY & STYLE RULES:
- Subject lock: Keep exact physical material (sheet metal cladding / utility sheet roof stiffening) consistent through all scenes.
- Text Overlays: Small, transparent 1-3 word graphics anchored near lower third. Never obstruct main visual action.
- Realism: Natural sunlight, real metallic textures, concrete terrace textures, real site hand tools, authentic South Indian construction site environment.

NEGATIVE PROMPT: NO cartoon, NO 2D explainer animation, NO plastic glossy CGI, NO floating graphics, NO full-screen logo cards, NO fake futuristic landmarks, NO presenter face speaking directly to camera, NO landscape aspect ratio, NO black side bars.
pack.title_english: Stop Sheet Roof Noise in Coimbatore Winds: The X-Crease Secret
pack.caption_english: High wind gusts during Coimbatore monsoon and Aadi seasons often cause flat metal sheet roofs and terrace shade panels to rattle and drum loudly. This vibration, known as oil-canning, occurs when flat metal sheets lack structural stiffening. By applying diagonal cross-break creasing (X-ribbing) during panel fabrication, sheet rigidity increases dramatically without adding heavy steel frames. This practical technique keeps your utility roofing and metal cladding rigid, quiet, and wind-resistant. Contact OliveTree Builders in Coimbatore for durable, engineered home construction!
